title: Stranger Anxiety
description: A face you've never seen before leans into your space. It smiles. It speaks in sounds you don't recognize. Every instinct in your small body screams retreat — this is wrong, this person is wrong, this cannot be safe. But the face keeps coming closer, and someone you trust is watching.

outcomes.narration: You press yourself against the familiar warmth of your caregiver's leg. The stranger waits, patient, unbothered. Eventually, your curiosity wins — you peek out, and the stranger makes a funny face. A small laugh escapes you.

You refuse to look away. The stranger shifts, uncomfortable, unsure what to make of this tiny critic. Your silence is a verdict. Eventually the stranger steps back, uncertain. You've made your position clear.
Your arm extends, trembling slightly. The stranger's eyes widen — then soften. Their hand meets yours, warm and unexpected. You chose the harder thing, and it did not destroy you.

Your arm reaches out, but your body betrays you — a cry escapes before you can stop it. The stranger recoils, and your caregiver scoops you up quickly. The moment passes. Some doors close before you can walk through them.
